name: AC-033 Manrope article-cover master

background.texture: none; a flat, uninterrupted fill with no grain, noise, filter or gradient

headline.fontFileNote: Manrope variable font, fvar wght 200-800, default instance ExtraLight 200. A weight token alone does not instance it; the renderer pins the axis with font-variation-settings 'wght' 800.

authorName.fontFileNote: Static wght=600 instance of the same Manrope source. It carries no fvar table, so no axis is set. Its internal name table still reads Manrope ExtraLight; the renderer addresses it by alias, never by its embedded family name.

illustration.headlineClearance: The illustration begins at x=604. Text never extends past x=583.
illustration.scaleRule: Keep the primary inlet on x=604 and the branch tips within the canvas. Scale article-specific illustration 0.95–1.05 only; retain at least 20px from the headline reserve.

shortHeadlineRule: Set deliberate sentence-case line breaks of no more than two lines. Do not reduce size, tracking, or distort Manrope to fit.
escalationRule: If accurate copy cannot fit the locked box in two lines, return a shorter accurate wording for copy approval. Do not redesign the cover.

measuredFit.method: Pixel ink extent of each line rendered by @napi-rs/canvas at the locked settings above; see exports/ac-033-render-provenance.json.
measuredFit.note: At the mandated 800/-3px settings the approved AC-033 wording does not fit the locked box. Recorded here so no future build re-derives tracking from a wrong-weight measurement.
